items.title: Hard-rename every KOALA_* env var to LATTICE_* across code, JSON config, wrapper assets, and hook-contract docs (no koala fallback)
items.context: Eliminate KOALA_* env vars with no fallback: (a) for the 17 vars with a LATTICE_* dual-read twin, delete the `|| process.env.KOALA_X` fallback (e.g. registry.ts:289, cli-validate.ts:7); (b) for the 38 KOALA-only vars, RENAME process.env.KOALA_X -> process.env.LATTICE_X across reads AND setters (incl. bin/lattice-codex.js setters), JSON configs, .Codex/ and .claude/ wrapper assets, and hook-contract docs (docs/guide-hooks.md: KOALA_COMMAND/KOALA_NEW_PHASE/KOALA_OLD_PHASE/KOALA_PHASE/KOALA_STAGE). Do NOT touch LEGACY_KOALA_* path constants in core/lattice-paths.ts (those belong to the deferred .koala path work). After the change `npm run build` must pass.
items.userSees: `npm run build` passes; grepping code/config/wrappers for KOALA_ env names returns nothing.

items.title: Update tests and smoke fixtures that assert KOALA_* env-var names so the suite reflects LATTICE_* only
items.context: The smoke/regression tests that set or assert KOALA_* env names (e.g. runtime-environment-checks, codex-adapter, hook-contract, health, story-owner-lease smokes) must be updated to LATTICE_*. Recorded historical fixtures that legitimately contain KOALA_ as past data are out of scope unless they gate a test. After the change `npm run test:e2e` and the affected `npm run test:*` suites must pass.
items.userSees: `npm run test:e2e` passes and the env-related smoke suites pass with LATTICE_* assertions.

items.title: Drop the docs/koala/legacy/ archive and add the residual-scan verification gate
items.context: git rm -r docs/koala/legacy/ (12 files, an archive with 0 code references; docs/koala/framework-audit/ is an ACTIVE path and must be KEPT). Then verify: a scan for KOALA_ env-var names (pattern KOALA_[A-Z]) over packages/, scripts/, bin/, .Codex/, .claude/ returns zero; `npm run build` and `npm run test:e2e` both pass. The koala-to-lattice execution-plan decision doc and truthful CHANGELOG/history are documented exceptions and out of scope.
items.userSees: docs/koala/legacy/ is gone; a KOALA_ env-name scan over code/config/wrappers returns zero; build + e2e pass.
